run_humanoid_knee_simulation: run the pybullet humanoid knee position control simulation with GUI debug sliders
run_load_humanoid_mjcf: run the pybullet script to load a humanoid MJCF model and control all joints
run_knee_joint_position_control: run the pybullet script to control left and right knee joints via position control
run_debug_parameter_sliders: run the pybullet script that creates debug sliders for knee angle and max force
run_simulation_step_loop: run the pybullet simulation loop that steps physics and reads user debug parameters
